mapper.sql: warehouse_id, tenant_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, delete_lock_at, disuse_at, stock_qty_disp_at, stock_io_at, safety_stock_alert_at, stock_default_at, plant_id, customer_id, manager_user_id, department_id, tel_no, fax_no, address, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, (SELECT u.user_nm FROM tb_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = tb_warehouse.tenant_id AND u.user_id = tb_warehouse.manager_user_id) AS manager_user_name, (SELECT d.department_nm FROM tb_department d WHERE d.tenant_id = tb_warehouse.tenant_id AND d.department_id = tb_warehouse.department_id) AS department_name
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_warehouse ( tenant_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, delete_lock_at, disuse_at, stock_qty_disp_at, stock_io_at, safety_stock_alert_at, stock_default_at, plant_id, customer_id, manager_user_id, department_id, tel_no, fax_no, address, remark, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{warehouseType}, #{deleteLockAt}, #{disuseAt}, #{stockQtyDispAt}, #{stockIoAt}, #{safetyStockAlertAt}, #{stockDefaultAt}, #{plantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{customerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{managerUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{departmentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{telNo}, #{faxNo}, #{address}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} ) RETURNING warehouse_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_warehouse SET warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, warehouse_type = #{warehouseType}, delete_lock_at = #{deleteLockAt}, disuse_at = #{disuseAt}, stock_qty_disp_at = #{stockQtyDispAt}, stock_io_at = #{stockIoAt}, safety_stock_alert_at = #{safetyStockAlertAt}, stock_default_at = #{stockDefaultAt}, plant_id = #{plantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, customer_id = #{customerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, manager_user_id = #{managerUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, department_id = #{departmentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, tel_no = #{telNo}, fax_no = #{faxNo}, address = #{address}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.department_id, d.department_nm, u.user_nm, la.profile_image, CASE WHEN lg.group_code = 'LEVEL' THEN li.item_nm END AS level_nm FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id AND la.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND la.use_at = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id AND d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item li ON li.common_code_item_id = u.level_id AND li.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND li.use_at = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group lg ON lg.common_code_group_id = li.group_id AND lg.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND lg.group_code = 'LEVEL' AND lg.use_at = 'Y' WHERE u.tenant_id = #{value} AND u.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY u.user_nm ASC, u.user_id ASC
